verdict.rationale: Clerk ships official SDKs: the clerk/javascript GitHub repo, a documented Next.js integration that a community user praised, MCP and CLI tooling that feed agents up-to-date Clerk SDK snippets, and a published OpenAPI spec for the Backend API. One community comment criticizes the libraries as bloated and obfuscated, which lowers confidence but does not contradict that the SDKs exist and work. Missing for 10: an enumerated list of supported SDK languages and frameworks, SDK reference documentation in the pack, and independent hands-on corroboration beyond Next.js.
